description: Create a cryptographically signed, timestamped receipt proving that an agent performed an action. Call this immediately after any consequential action (approving an invoice, validating a supplier, sending a payment instruction, making a decision affecting a person) to build an audit trail that satisfies record-keeping obligations such as EU AI Act Articles 12 and 26. Pass the action details; if you include a payload it is SHA-256 hashed and immediately discarded — contents are never stored. Returns the signed receipt JSON, which verifies offline.

actor.description: Identifier of the acting agent, e.g. 'agent:ap-bot@acme'

context.description: Optional string key/value context, e.g. {jurisdiction: 'EU', system: 'erp-prod'}

payload.description: Optional action payload (any JSON). Hashed with SHA-256 and discarded, never stored.

payload_hash.description: Optional precomputed 'sha256:<hex>' if you hash the payload yourself (hash-only mode)

principal.description: The human or organization the agent acts for

summary.description: One-line human-readable description of what was done

name: issue_receipt
title: Issue a signed action receipt
